key_idea: Knapsack on the first intern's total time: dp[s] = minimum total time of the second intern when the first intern's tasks sum to exactly s; answer is min over s of max(s, dp[s]).
sketch: Process tasks one at a time; for each reachable s (iterated downward, in place) either give the task to intern one (s+a, same dp) or to intern two (same s, dp+b). The sum of a is at most 50*1e5 = 5e6, so the table has 5e6 ints and the work is about 2.5e8 simple operations, well inside 3 s (0.06 s locally on the max case). Iterating s downward while overwriting dp[s] with the 'second intern' option keeps it a single array. Stress-tested against a 2^n brute force.
